description.text: Aim:The objective of this course is to familiarize students with basic theoretical knowledge of environmental science and engineering in order that they may develop into technical or management experts in maritime or related fields. Related courses: ●Principles of environmental engineering experimentation; ●Environmental monitoring technology; ●Hazardous material management; ●Pollution prevention technology for ships and ports; ●Marine resource management.

duration.text: The Environmental Engineering at Shanghai Maritime University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Application Documents 1. Application Form 2. Self-introduction Video The video should not exceed 5 minutes. The contents should cover your personality, hobbies, high school performance and rewards. If you apply for a Chinese-taught program, the video should be made in Chinese. If you apply for an English-taught program, the video should be made in English. 3. High School Diploma or Official Proof of Expected Graduation The diploma/Proof must be in Chinese or English, with the official school stamp or by the embassy’ notarization. 4. Transcripts Transcripts must be in Chinese or English, with the official school stamp or by the embassy’s notarization. 5. Language Credentials ●For Chinese-taught program: HSK 5 certificate. Exemption of Chinese Proficiency Certificate: (1) Native Chinese speakers; (2) Applicants whose previous high school program was taught in Chinese. ●For English-taught program: IELTS 6.0/ TOFEL 80/ Cambridge English B2 (or above) certificate dated within the recent two years. Exemption of English Proficiency Certificate: (1) Native English speakers; (2) Applicants whose high school program was taught in English; (3) Applicants who can provide other equivalent English proficiency certificates. The certificates must be reviewed and approved by SMU. 6. Study Statement The statement should not be less than 800 words. The contents should cover study and work experience, academic qualification, research plan, and career goal after graduation. 7. Copy of Passport Bio-data The passport page with your biographical data (name, date of birth, passport number, expiration date, place of issue, passport type information, and photo. 8. Medical Examination Report 9. Certificate of No Criminal Conviction 10.Statement of Financial Support

requirements.text: ●High school graduate students, between the ages of 18 - 25 years, and in good health. ●Chinese citizens who apply to study abroad as an international student after they have immigrated to a foreign country must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for four years or more. Applicants should provide proof of residence abroad for more than two years.
